context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

Which gen_ai.operation.name values does AI Center treat as metadata-only, and what does that mean for where messages must go?

checklist.name: metadata-only-operation-list
checklist.description: Lists invoke_agent, invoke_workflow, create_agent, embeddings and retrieval as metadata-only, so message content placed on them is not rendered.

checklist.name: messages-on-inference-spans
checklist.description: States that messages belong on inference spans (chat, text_completion, generate_content), one per model call.

checklist.name: no-wrapper-rendering-claim
checklist.description: Does not claim that messages on invoke_agent render, or that rendering depends on the content-capture switch. FAIL if it says either.
